view.label: Show
head: Runs
newest: The newest {{n}} of {{total}}. All runs lists the rest.
title: All runs
beyond_one: {{count}} more running workflow is not kept open from here.
beyond_other: {{count}} more running workflows are not kept open from here.
d.notFound: This run is no longer listed.
steps.gone: The agent no longer keeps this run's steps.
steps.failed: The steps could not be read.
act.label: Actions for this run
cancel.title: Cancel this run of {{name}}?
cancel.body: No further steps run. Steps already done stay done.
resume.title: Resume this run of {{name}}?
resume.body: It continues in its own chat from the first unfinished step, and costs what its model calls cost.
out.cancel.done: Cancelled: the run reads cancelled. Steps already done stay done.
out.ended.completed: No longer running (it finished as completed). It was not cancelled.
out.ended.failed: No longer running (it finished as failed). It was not cancelled.
out.busy: Its chat is busy, so nothing was resumed. Try again when the chat is idle.
out.cancel.gone: The agent no longer has this run. Nothing was cancelled.
out.resume.gone: The run or its chat is no longer there, so nothing was resumed.
out.spendCap: A spending limit, or a spending-limit file the agent cannot read, stopped the resume. Nothing was spent.
out.policy: Its chat asks before every tool, so the run cannot resume there. Nothing was resumed.
out.notSent: Not sent: nothing changed. You can try again.
out.unheld: Its chat could not be kept open, so nothing was resumed. Try again in a moment.
out.cancel.unsure: Whether the cancel went through is not known. It is not sent again from here.
out.resume.unsure: Whether the run resumed is not known; if it did, it spends. It is not sent again from here. After Stop tracking, a new Resume may be a second paid run.
seen.unchecked: Check again to read the runs.
seen.failed: The runs could not be read. Try Check again in a moment.
seen.none.cancel: This run is no longer listed.
seen.none.resume: No resumed run is listed yet. Check again in a moment.
seen.unclear: A newer run of this one is listed, but the agent's answer did not say which run this Resume started, so it may be from another tab. It is not counted as this Resume.
seen.missing: Its new run is still not listed, so it most likely never started. It is not sent again from here. If you are sure nothing ran, Stop tracking lets you resume again.
seen.cut: Its new run is listed as failed with no step recorded and no finish time, so whether it ran steps is not known. If more is needed, resume that newer run once it has stopped.
seen.starting: Its new run is listed, but no step has started yet; its chat can still refuse it. Check again in a moment.
moved: This page now shows another computer, account or realm. Nothing is sent from here.
out.cancel.accepted: The agent took the cancel: no further steps start, and steps already done stay done. Reading how the run ended.
out.unread: The runs could not be read first, so nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.
out.resumed: A newer run of this one is already listed, and it may have run steps. Nothing was sent. If more is needed, resume the newer run once it has stopped.
out.superseded: A newer run of this one has already run steps, so the agent did not resume this one. Nothing was started. If more is needed, resume the newer run.
out.lineage: The agent could not read this run's history, so nothing was started. Try again in a moment.
out.dropped: Its chat dropped the resume before any step started, so nothing ran. You can try again.
out.resume.accepted: The agent took the resume; it is not sent again from here. Its chat can still drop it, so it counts as resumed once its new run has started a step. After Stop tracking, a new Resume may be a second paid run.
newChat.title: Resume this run of {{name}} in a new chat?
newChat.body: A new chat opens in the run's folder on this computer, and the run continues there from the first unfinished step. It costs what its model calls cost.
out.newChat.notReady: The agent on this computer is not ready to make a chat for this account, so nothing was made or resumed.
out.newChat.binding: The agent made the chat somewhere else, so it was not used. The run was not resumed and nothing was spent.
out.newChat.refused: The agent did not make the new chat, so the run was not resumed.
out.newChat.unsure: A new chat may have been made. The run was not resumed.
out.newChat.unsure.detail: This page cannot check it. If it was made, it stays empty and closes by itself within 5 minutes. After Stop tracking you can try again.
forgetBody: Stop tracking only if you know it did not go through. If it did, trying again may do it twice.
